# Read by no check: a worklist for a person, like the censuses beside it.
# TWO THINGS THIS READ CORRECTED, both of them mine from 2026-09-11:
#  * "27 components" was 27 VARIANTS. The earlier classifier stopped at the nearest COMPONENT, which
#    inside a set is the variant — so `Link=Key actions` and `Link=MHR` were counted as two
#    components when they are two variants of `Mobile key actions`. Climbing to the SET gives 15.
#  * `Full page`, `Header` and `Mobile key actions` are NOT "already clean". CLAUDE.md has said so
#    since 2026-09-11. They hold 9, 3 and 6 of these 35 between them — over half the job. That claim
#    was scoped to the colours being measured at the time and was written as though it were general,
#    which is the scope error this repo keeps finding in itself.
# DIRECT vs VIA A NESTED INSTANCE is where the edit goes, not whether it ships. A node inside an
# instance that is itself inside a component master is published content of that master; the style
# is an override on the nested instance. 13 are direct, 22 are through a nested instance — and 20 of
# those 22 are in just three components.
